# Soulstone

> Soulstone is the Shopify and Shopify Plus practice of Marin Gerov, an independent developer and conversion specialist based in Amsterdam (Europe/Amsterdam timezone). He works with a small number of premium, design-led brands (watches, cars, crafts and other objects made with care), mostly through referrals. The work covers product pages, navigation and checkout flows, re-architecting overgrown Shopify Plus stores, checkout and customer account extensions, product data and integrations, and connecting marketing spend to on-site revenue.

Contact: marin@soulstone.co. First step is a free 30-minute store teardown.
Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/maringerov, https://x.com/maringerov, https://www.linkedin.com/company/soulstone

## Services
- [Independent Shopify Plus developer in Amsterdam](https://soulstone.co/shopify-plus-developer-amsterdam/): who the work is for, services, process and FAQ.
- [Shopify Plus architecture](https://soulstone.co/shopify-plus-architecture/): re-architecting complex Plus setups, app consolidation, performance.
- [Results](https://soulstone.co/results/): anonymised case study of a premium Shopify Plus rebuild.
- [FAQ](https://soulstone.co/faq/): fit, engagement model, teardown, how lift is measured.
- [Win Chat](https://soulstone.co/win-chat/): getting Shopify brands found, cited and recommended in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI answers. Audit, Setup Sprint, Monitoring, or built into a new store. A separate practice from Soulstone that runs alongside the Shopify Plus development and architecture work.

## Journal
- [How do I add a gift with purchase on Shopify?](https://soulstone.co/blog/shopify-gift-with-purchase-setup/): Native Buy X Get Y works, but Shopify never adds the gift to the cart for you. When that is fine, when you need a Function or an app, and the checkout edge cases.
- [How do I customize Shopify checkout with extensibility?](https://soulstone.co/blog/customize-shopify-checkout-extensibility/): Visible changes go in checkout UI extensions, logic goes in Shopify Functions, looks go in the branding API. What each can do, and what needs Plus.
- [No-nonsense Shopify development: take complexity out before you add more](https://soulstone.co/blog/no-nonsense-shopify-development/): Most overblown Shopify stacks don't need another app or a rebuild. Find who writes what, use what Shopify already runs, and ship small. Four rules I work by, with two real cases.
- [How do I migrate to checkout extensibility after checkout.liquid and Additional scripts?](https://soulstone.co/blog/checkout-extensibility-migration-tracking/): Tracking moves to Customer events, visible changes move to UI extensions, and theme code never runs in checkout. The 15-minute check and the fixes.
- [The price keeps reverting. The theme is not the problem.](https://soulstone.co/blog/price-keeps-reverting-theme-not-the-problem/): A sale price came back overnight after a manual fix. How I traced the real writer in Shopify, and why I map every writer before touching code.
- [owner_type in checkout extension metafields: add it now, before 2027-01 blocks your deploy](https://soulstone.co/blog/checkout-extension-metafields-owner-type/): From API 2026-10, checkout and customer account UI extensions can set owner_type on metafields. From 2027-01 it is required. The change and a repo check.
- [On premium Shopify stores, mobile speed is a conversion lever, not an IT metric](https://soulstone.co/blog/mobile-speed-conversion-premium-shopify/): Why Core Web Vitals quietly cap revenue on premium Shopify Plus stores, what actually slows them down, and the order to fix it in.
- [Most premium brands don't have a traffic problem. They have a conversion problem.](https://soulstone.co/blog/conversion-not-traffic-problem/): Why established premium brands keep buying more attention to fix a problem that lives on the store, and how to tell the difference before you spend another euro on ads.
- [Replatforming is usually the wrong answer](https://soulstone.co/blog/replatforming-usually-wrong-answer/): When a premium Shopify Plus store feels broken, replatforming feels like the fix. It usually isn't. Here's how to decide between a rebuild and a re-architecture.
- [The anatomy of a product page that closes premium buyers](https://soulstone.co/blog/premium-product-page-anatomy/): Premium customers decide fast. Here's what belongs above the fold on a high-end Shopify product page, and the order of information that turns intent into a sale.
- [The hidden cost of Shopify Plus app sprawl](https://soulstone.co/blog/hidden-cost-shopify-plus-app-sprawl/): How a dozen well-intentioned apps quietly become the reason your store is slow, fragile, and expensive to change, and how to think about consolidating them without a risky replatform.
- Feed: https://soulstone.co/rss.xml
